snippet.title: The Next BIG Gameplay Trailer Teaser is Finally Here! | Cryorbis Studio
snippet.description:
The game title, Steam page and more updates will be announced soon! Follow us on Youtube and Facebook for more updates. It took us 40 days to create this 2:47 min video. We hope you enjoy it!
Please subscribe, and like our video! It means a lot to us!

Want to support us?
- You are always welcome to support us with anything. We have very few resources, developers, artists and budgets to keep the development alive. Your support will always help us.
- Click this link to support us!
https://www.paypal.com/donate?campaign_id=843BU8JATHTGN


FAQ:
1. How do I contact you?
- You can send us an email at cryorbisstudio@gmail.com or you can send us a message on our Facebook page.
 
2. What if it's a scam?
- This donation is optional. We understand without a proper campaign like Kickstarter or Patreon it is more likely lean towards the 'scam'. But, our titles and published work should answer the question. You can see our work on Youtube or our Facebook page. 

3. How long does this game being developed?
- This game was first developed in mid-year 2020 and we released our first prototype gameplay in 2021 (You can watch the prototype on our youtube channel). On October 2022 we released our very first gameplay mechanics with environments and proper models. More updates on the development will be coming soon!

4. Why not use Kickstarter or Patreon?
- These platforms require weekly/daily updates of rewards to the supporter. We are currently in need to focus on the development. We understand that we can do both at the same time, but we are a very small team working on the game. These platforms (Patreon and Kickstarter) require time, effort and budgets to provide the rewards which we can't really promise it yet. The good news is, we will launch it in a few months when the development stage is stable. For not, you can click here to support us!
https://www.paypal.com/donate?campaign_id=843BU8JATHTGN



Follow our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/cryorbisstudio

Music Credits:
AlexiAction and
Filaments by Scott Buckley


Best Regards, Cryorbis Studio.
